ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-
1, Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 3-I in the area bound by:

      West Division Street; a line 250.71 feet east of and parallel to North Rockwell
      Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Division Street; and a line
      225.71 feet east of and parallel to North Rockwell Avenue,

      to those of a B1-2, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective upon its passage and approval.




                                                      _________________________________________

                                                      Jessie Fuentes
                                                      Alderwoman, 26th Ward




Common Address:
2537 West Division Street
